reviews.author: azul nieto
reviews.es:
¡El Dr. Bruno fue mi salvación a pocos días de mi boda! Llegué con un mal trabajo previo de bótox y labios, bastante preocupada por cómo iba a solucionarlo, y superó por completo mis expectativas. ¡No saben el alivio y la felicidad que sentí con el resultado! ❤️

Además de ser un excelente profesional y tener muchísimo conocimiento, es una persona que te transmite confianza desde el primer momento. La clínica y todo su equipo, te atienden de verdad de primera.

Definitivamente me quedo con él para mis próximos tratamientos.
reviews.en:
Dr. Bruno was my savior just days before my wedding! I arrived with a botched previous Botox and lip filler job, quite worried about how he was going to fix it, and he completely exceeded my expectations. You can't imagine the relief and happiness I felt with the result! ❤️

Besides being an excellent professional with a wealth of knowledge, he's someone who inspires confidence from the very first moment. The clinic and its entire team truly provide top-notch service.

I will definitely be going back to him for my future treatments.

reviews.author: Giovanni Andres
reviews.en: Excellent service and atmosphere, Dr. Bruno is very professional.

reviews.author: Cristina Serment G
reviews.es: Increíble experiencia, el Dr Bruno es lo máximo. Desde que llegas es muy amable, se enfoca completamente en tus necesidades individuales, te va explicando todo a lo largo de la consulta, dominio y conocimiento de sus productos y sus procedimientos. Lo recomiendo ampliamente.
reviews.en: Incredible experience! Dr. Bruno is the best. From the moment you arrive, he's incredibly kind, focusing entirely on your individual needs and explaining everything throughout the consultation. He has a deep understanding and knowledge of his products and procedures. I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Len
reviews.en: Dr. Bruno and staff are not only experts, but kind, generous and professional. I always go to Eternal Glow for wrinkle relaxers/Dysport and Dr. Bruno does exceptional work at a great price. He also treated me last-minute for reoccurring sebaceous glands that only went away with his help! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: MARTIN MENDOZA
reviews.es: Me encantó 😍 Súper rápido, cero dolor y excelente atención. Quedé feliz con el resultado! 100% recomendado
reviews.en: I loved it! 😍 Super fast, zero pain, and excellent service. I'm thrilled with the result! 100% recommended

reviews.author: Omar Sonoma
reviews.es: Trato profesional, explica a detalle cada procedimiento, muy humano. Gracias por asesorarme y atenderme de la mejor manera!!
reviews.en: Professional service, explains each procedure in detail, very friendly. Thank you for advising me and taking such good care of me!

reviews.author: Paola G
reviews.es: Muy amable y súper gracioso el doctor. Me hice una armonización facial completa con él, incluyendo nariz, labios, otras áreas del rostro y Botox. Quedé encantada con los resultados. ¡Me veo magnífica! Lo recomiendo 100%.
reviews.en: The doctor was very kind and super funny. I had a full facial harmonization done with him, including my nose, lips, other areas of my face, and Botox. I'm thrilled with the results. I look amazing! I highly recommend him.

reviews.author: Victoria Skye
reviews.en: Got my smile back! My experience with Dr. Bruno was really special. I had a very pronounced lump from filler I got done 3 months ago, as shown in the first picture. It made me feel very insecure when I smiled or when talking to people. He was willing to help me remove it quickly and painlessly. He didn’t even charge me for the quick procedure, which was so generous and kind. You can tell he really wants to help & make a difference. I would definitely come back when it’s time for a touch up for my filler!

reviews.author: Sara Steinkruger
reviews.en: I highly recommend coming to see Dr. Bruno! I had botox done around my eyes, and prior to seeing Dr. Bruno I was never 100% happy with the results. This is the first time I genuinely have no notes. He got it exactly right, and I couldn't be happier with how it all turned out. So glad I found him! :)

reviews.author: Diana Laura Hernández Luevano
reviews.es: La mejor atención del doctor Bruno, excelente experiencia. Desde que llegué me hicieron sentir muy cómoda y me explicaron todo el procedimiento con mucha paciencia y profesionalismo. El ácido hialurónico en mi nariz quedó muy natural, justo como lo quería. El lugar es impecable, Lety es muy amable y se nota la calidad de los productos que utilizan. Sin duda volveré y los recomiendo al 100%.
reviews.en: Dr. Bruno provided the best care; it was an excellent experience. From the moment I arrived, they made me feel very comfortable and explained the entire procedure with great patience and professionalism. The hyaluronic acid in my nose looks very natural, just as I wanted. The place is spotless, Lety is very kind, and the quality of the products they use is evident. I will definitely return and recommend them 100%.

reviews.author: Sarah Pickle
reviews.en: Highly recommend this place especially if you’re from the US and nervous about trying a place in CDMX. Dr.Bruno speaks perfect english and is very professional. It also is cheaper than what I pay in Texas

reviews.author: Joseph Imonti-Cortes
reviews.en: Dr. Bruno was absolutely wonderful! Super informative and knowledgeable and didn’t attempt to upsell at all. Would highly recommend to anyone interested in the treatments that he offers.

reviews.author: E T
reviews.en: I’ve now seen Dr. Bruno twice for Xeomin and have recently started Sculptra with him. He’s genuinely knowledgeable, explains everything clearly, and has a skilled, precise touch that gives me real confidence in his work. He’s also just a warm, friendly person—the kind of doctor who puts you at ease during procedures, which makes a big difference for me as someone who hates needles!  I trust him fully and will absolutely be returning!

reviews.author: Johana Ducloux
reviews.es: Me encantó el resultado, el trato fue super amable y me explicaron todo muy bn y contestaron todas mis preguntas! Lo recomiendo muchísimo de vdd!
reviews.en: I loved the result, the service was super friendly, they explained everything very well and answered all my questions! I highly recommend them, truly!

reviews.author: D A
reviews.en: Received excellent treatment and care at Dr Bruno’s clinic last month on our trip from Canada. The Botox worked out very well! He was caring and friendly so I mentioned I had some filler I wished to get fixed but had been reluctant to, but it was bothering me. He discussed it with me and dissolved it carefully and I am extremely happy with the outcome. Thank you!

reviews.author: Yerandy Berenice Chavez Avila
reviews.es:
Desde que llegué, el trato fue muy amable y profesional. Las instalaciones son limpias, cómodas y transmiten mucha confianza. El personal se toma el tiempo de explicar cada procedimiento y realmente se nota la atención al detalle.
El Dr Bruno súper profesional
Quedé muy satisfecha con los resultados y definitivamente volvería. Súper recomendada.
reviews.en:
From the moment I arrived, the service was incredibly friendly and professional. The facilities are clean, comfortable, and inspire a great sense of security. The staff takes the time to explain each procedure, and their attention to detail is truly evident.
Dr. Bruno is exceptionally professional. I was very satisfied with the results and would definitely return. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: mike De
reviews.es:
Anteriormente acudí a otra clínica, la cual sentí que no me funcionó el Botox, agende una cita con el doctor Bruno, y todo cambió, notó que no me hicieron el tratamiento correcto y el que me realizó fue 100% efectivo.

Recomendado 100% y bastante profesional, la persona de recepción muy amable y cordial.

El mejor consultorio en la Roma Norte y CDMX
reviews.en:
I previously went to another clinic, where I felt the Botox didn't work for me. I scheduled an appointment with Dr. Bruno, and everything changed. He noticed I hadn't received the correct treatment, and the one he performed was 100% effective.

100% recommended. He's very professional, and the receptionist was very kind and friendly.

The best clinic in Roma Norte and Mexico City.

reviews.author: Alicia Vera
reviews.es:
Sin duda la mejor clínica estética en la CDMX!! El Doctor Bruno súper amable y profesional desde un principio, te explica todos los procedimientos a detalle además de que resuelve todas tus dudas.

Al momento de aplicación de procedimientos te explica todo y enseña lo que te pone, eso me parece súper profesional.

La señorita de recepción súper amable también; muy linda y atenta.

No le confío mi carita a nadie más que él, ya hasta llevé a una amiga.

No duden en ir con él, de verdad. ❤️✨
reviews.en:
Without a doubt, the best aesthetic clinic in Mexico City!! Dr. Bruno is incredibly kind and professional from the very beginning. He explains all the procedures in detail and answers all your questions.

During the procedures, he explains everything and shows you what he's injecting, which I find incredibly professional.

The receptionist is also super friendly; very kind and attentive.

I wouldn't trust my face to anyone else but him; I even brought a friend along.

Don't hesitate to go to him, seriously. ❤️✨

reviews.author: mojo
reviews.en: Love Dr. Bruno...super knowledgeable, bilingual & a joy to visit

reviews.author: Steven Bassett
reviews.en: I have been twice and had great service. Very knowledgeable and helpful everyone. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Vane Rot
reviews.en: They put Sculptra there and it's the best thing in the world! I'm so happy!!

reviews.author: elizabeth hanon
reviews.es:
Ame ….. termine con las 3 dosis de sculptra FELIZ una mano divina
Y el Botox lo más !!!!
reviews.en:
I loved it... I finished all 3 doses of Sculptra. So happy! A divine touch!
And the Botox was the best!!!!

reviews.author: Jacquie Siegel
reviews.en:
I highly recommended visiting  Eternal Glow. Bruno is professional, knowledgeable, fluent in Spanish and English and has been a joy to work with so far.

I visited Bruno for a second opinion, I had a nightmare experience at another clinic in Mexico City where they were trying to convince me that I needed to have facial surgery to address filler migration. He was able to immediately dissolve my filler on the spot and I left crying tears because I had been on such an emotional rollercoaster. My face is returning to normal and I couldn’t be happier!

reviews.author: Dulce Isela Martínez Morales
reviews.es: Me encanta es super atento, se preocupan por ti y los resultados maravillosos, amo el lugar
reviews.en: I love it, they're super attentive, they care about you, and the results are wonderful. I love the place.

reviews.author: Sara Maya
reviews.en:
Obviously, it’s always really scary choosing a new med spa especially one in another country but the Eternal Glow team and Dr. Bruno made it such a pleasure to be there so smooth and truly a great time I look forward to visiting anytime I need a quick touchup in CDMX!

It was one of the smoothest easiest appointments I’ve ever had and I’m looking fabulous. Thank you Dr. Bruno!!

reviews.author: Lisa Hinton
reviews.en: I’ve been seeing Dr. Bruno for almost a year now and he’s the best! I get botox and fillers. Botox- he does a 2 week checkup/touchup if needed for free. Fillers- unlike most doctors, he listens when I say I want a natural result and doesn’t try to up-sell me. Everything he has done on me has been amazing. Not to mention he’s so fun and easy to talk to. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Eliam Mecalco
reviews.es: Muy buen trabajo! super recomendable la verdad me arreglo un mal trabajo y no saben cómo me ayudó de verdad!!

reviews.author: Aremith Avalos
reviews.en:
I visited Eternal Glow today, and I can confidently say I’ve found my go-to place. Being new to the city, I was worried about having to go through a lot of trial and error, but I’m so glad that’s not the case here.

The doctor is incredibly knowledgeable, kind, funny, and super outgoing—he made me feel completely at ease from the moment I walked in. The entire vibe of the clinic is welcoming and professional, and they truly made me feel right at home.

Highly recommend to anyone looking for quality care and a great experience!

reviews.author: Aldrin David Vargas Vargas

reviews.author: Tiffany Hsu
reviews.en: Dr. Bruno gave me my first ever Botox treatment! I was a bit nervous, but he thoroughly consulted with me about my preferences and concerns, which made me feel much more confident and comfortable throughout the procedure. Dr. Bruno is fantastic and I highly highly recommend him!!

reviews.author: MARTHA RIVAS
reviews.es: 10/10 el doctor una maravilla, te trata exactamente lo que necesitas y tiene muchas opciones diferentes de tratamientos

reviews.author: Gemi Labador
reviews.en: This is the best clinic in mexico for all your beauty needs. The doctor really has magic hands- you just have to see it for yourself. You cannot just simply trust anyone! I will keep coming back here for sure.

reviews.author: Candyce Le
reviews.en: Dr. Bruno was amazing! He was so welcoming and informative about the procedures and made me and my friends feel so comfortable❤️ highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Jamie Crutchfield
reviews.en: I had such a great experience with my PDO threads here! The doctor was able to get me in very quickly for the procedure and was helpful in listening to my goals. reviews.author: Sue Yáñez
reviews.es: Excelente en todo, muy buena mano para hacer los tratamientos y productos de primera. Amamos al Doctor Bruno

Excellent service and very professional

reviews.en: Eternal glow is a game changer. The space was beautiful & chic. The staff was incredibly professional.   Dr.Bruno, the injector, was a true artist and knew exactly what I needed to freshen up my look without overdoing it.  Zero downtime & flawless results!  Thank you!

reviews.en: Dr Bruno was amazing! I’m always so nervous to do anything to my face and he made me feel very comfortable and like I was in great, professional hands. Already so happy with the results! He was also very informative. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: jursica08
reviews.en: Dr. Ocampo is amazing! I got my lips done with filler for the first time, and he was incredibly patient and thorough. reviews.author: Pamela Carrillo
reviews.es: Excelente experiencia con el Dr. Bruno Ocampo. Desde el primer momento fue extremadamente acogedor, amable y cercano, lo que me hizo sentir muy cómoda. Los resultados fueron excelentes y superaron mis expectativas. Sin duda lo recomiendo ampliamente.
reviews.en: Excellent experience with Dr. Bruno Ocampo. From the very first moment, he was extremely welcoming, kind, and approachable, which made me feel very comfortable. His manner is warm and hospitable, in addition to being highly professional. I highly recommend him.

Everything felt subtle and intentional. enhancing without overdoing. I’ve been 3 times already and will definitely be back. Thank you Bruno.
